lines.trans: The meeting with the Minister of Culture went great!
They allocated big money to us for the monastery.
How much money exactly did they allocate to us?
Three hundred and fifty million rubles per estimate!
You should have asked for an entire billion!
Arkady, you are an unofficial adviser to the mayor after all!
That is exactly what I am advising!
We will create a real historical center here.
Sineozersk will enter the famous Golden Ring!
I already have a preliminary project ready.
Excellent, Marina Sergeyevna, well done!
With that, our meeting has ended.
I congratulate all of us on a mutual victory!
A wonderful future awaits us ahead!

examples.trans: That is the future mayor of Sineozersk!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
You are an unofficial adviser to the mayor after all.
He works as a freelance correspondent.

examples.text: У нас ещё вся жизнь впереди.
examples.trans: We still have our whole life ahead of us.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выделить.gloss: to allocate, earmark; to single out

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!
The city allocated money for the school.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.trans: He's very good with his hands.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

meanings.note: about history: историческое наследие = historical heritage

examples.trans: This is the historic centre of the town.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
a thousand million; the counted thing follows in the genitive plural: 'миллиард рублей'
after numbers: два миллиона, пять миллионов

examples.text: Встреча с министром культуры прошла отлично.
examples.trans: The meeting with the Minister of Culture went great.
The minister signed an important decree.

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: He is the mayor of the town.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.
I know this town really well!

examples.text: У меня уже готов предварительный проект.
examples.trans: I already have a preliminary project ready.

meanings.note: a plan or piece of work

examples.trans: The project is at a standstill.

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: 'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order
просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness
the noun after it is genitive plural: пятьдесят метров

examples.trans: I haven't got a single rouble.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: По смете на ремонт требуется крупная сумма.
examples.trans: According to the estimate, a large sum is required for repairs.
We verified the approved expense budget.

meanings.note: советник по + dative = adviser on something

examples.trans: The mayor has a new adviser.

examples.text: Вот я как раз и советую!
examples.trans: That is exactly what I am advising!

examples.text: А для него это как триста!
examples.trans: And for him it's like three hundred!
The ticket costs three hundred roubles.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Я не могу гулять здесь целый день.
examples.trans: I can't walk around here all day.
We waited for a whole hour.

meanings.note: of a town; торговый центр = shopping centre

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
